defense_news.title: Estimates of Russians killed in Ukraine surpass all combined US war deaths since WWI
defense_news.summary: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the war in Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale war against the nation nearly five years ago.

defense_news.title: Blast heard, smoke seen rising over farmland near Iowa Army lead azide detonation site
defense_news.summary: The Army went ahead with its planned detonation of volatile lead azide reserves Wednesday morning, according to the service.

defense_news.title: US Air Force buys final KC-46 lot under Boeing’s original tanker deal
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon announced a $2.82 billion Boeing contract for 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers, the final production lot under the program's original 2011 contract.
